_meta.purpose: Traditionalist persona + precise/vague axis.  Response-detail axis (specific-numbers-and-ranges vs general-handwaving).  Traditionalist is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.50, n=4).  Trait poles ask near-identical 'how much/long/often' prompts; axis modulates whether the answer commits to numbers/ranges or stays general.  Question mix: 5 precise-trait quantitative prompts + 5 vague-trait same-shape prompts + 2 traditionalist-role probes + 1 extraction power + 1 hand-written.
